page_title: DOR 3-2 HAM | Dortmund v Hamburger SV 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' It is time for a substitution. Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is on for Felix Nmecha.
90+4' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+3' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
90+2' Dortmund take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. William Mikelbrencis will be replaced by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger).
90+1' Substitution. Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Warmed Omari walks off.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
89' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
86' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
84' 3 - 2 Goal! Daniel Heuer Fernandes gets a hand on the penalty from Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
84' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' Handball! A player from Hamburger SV handled the ball. It's a penalty for Dortmund!
80' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

80' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Daniel Heuer Fernandes has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Otto Stange (Hamburger) comes onto the pitch for Ransford Konigsdorffer.
78' 2 - 2 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
77' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' 7:6 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
73' 1 - 2 GOAL! Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Daniel Heuer Fernandes.
73' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is going to take the penalty!
72' This is a yellow card! William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' The Dortmund players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

71' Play continues despite the shouts by some Dortmund players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
68' Merlin Polzin has decided to substitute Philip Otele and he is replaced by Fabio Balde (Hamburger).
68' Philip Otele (Hamburger) picks up a caution.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Damion Downs (Hamburger) is replacing Fabio Vieira.
67' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger).

67' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play and Dortmund manage to earn a corner.
65' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) whips in a cross from the corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is well positioned and punches the ball away.

65' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' The ball possession at the moment is 66:34.

61' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
60' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marcel Sabitzer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund).
58' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Daniel Svensson is replaced by Fabio Silva (Dortmund).
57' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
56' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
54' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
52' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Daniel Heuer Fernandes.
49' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) replaces Luca Reggiani.
46' Half-time substitution. Karim Adeyemi is replaced by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matthias Jollenbeck, who decides to show him a yellow.
45+4' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
45+3' The game is interrupted as Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is flagged offside.
45+2' The ball is behind the sideline. Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes a throw-in.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' Warmed Omari (Hamburger) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a penalty! Dortmund have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
42' Dortmund have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Warmed Omari (Hamburger) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
40' Shots on target – 1:4.
38' 0 - 2 Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball into the roof of the net in trademark fashion.

36' CHANCE! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
35' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) will take the corner.

32' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
31' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
29' The Dortmund players can’t believe it after referee Matthias Jollenbeck signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

29' There's a break in play and referee Matthias Jollenbeck must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Dortmund using VAR. This could be interesting!
28' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
27' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle as Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
25' Hamburger SV have a goal ruled out for offside!
24' Hamburger SV take a short corner kick.

24' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Gregor Kobel, who makes a glorious save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Hamburger SV will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

19' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from William Mikelbrencis, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Philip Otele (Hamburger), who beats Gregor Kobel with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
16' The free kick from long range, taken by Hamburger SV, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
16' Rough tackle by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Hamburger SV.
15' The ball has crossed the sideline. Hamburger SV are taking a throw-in.
13' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
11' Great teamplay by Dortmund as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Dortmund fail to score from a corner as Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) leaps to collect the ball.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund. Dortmund have a corner.

7' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
5' The corner from Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is cleared away by the defence.
4' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
Hamburger SV will kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
